status.unavailableHelp: Home Assistant does not have a current status for the vacuum.
status.unavailableLiveStatus: {{status}}. Home Assistant does not have the vacuum's current status.
status.errorSourceUnavailableHelp: The current vacuum error status cannot be confirmed because its error source is unavailable.
status.queuedCleaningCanceled: The queued cleaning request was canceled because the vacuum is no longer ready. Retry when ready.
status.lastReportedMapHelp: This is the last map the vacuum reported before contact was lost. The exact report time is unknown, and the vacuum may have been moved since then.
status.mapUnavailableHelp: Home Assistant cannot currently confirm the vacuum's map or position.

completed.vacuumMop: Vacuuming and mopping completed for the room.
completed.fallbackVacuum: Fallback vacuuming completed for the room; mopping was not confirmed.

failed.vacuum: Vacuuming the room without mopping failed.
failed.vacuumMop: Vacuuming and mopping the room failed.
failed.fallbackVacuum: The fallback attempt to vacuum the room without mopping failed.

interrupted.vacuum: The vacuum-only attempt was interrupted before completion.
interrupted.vacuumMop: The vacuuming and mopping attempt was interrupted before completion.
interrupted.fallbackVacuum: The fallback vacuum-only attempt was interrupted before completion.

deferred.vacuum: Vacuuming was deferred before any attempt.
deferred.vacuumMop: Vacuuming and mopping were deferred before any attempt.
deferred.mop: Only mopping was deferred without being attempted.

primary.partialCredit: Home Assistant credited vacuuming; work may remain.

outstanding.vacuumMop: Combined vacuuming and mopping remain due.

reasons.cleanWaterEmpty: The mop dock's clean-water tank was empty; refill it.
reasons.mopAttachmentMissing: The vacuum's mop attachment was missing; attach it before mopping.
reasons.dirtyWaterUnavailable: The dirty-water tank was unavailable; check it before mopping.
reasons.cleaningLiquidUnavailable: Mop cleaning liquid was unavailable; check it before mopping.
reasons.mopHardwareUnavailable: The mop hardware was unavailable; check it before mopping.
reasons.autoEmptyBlocked: The auto-empty dock dust bag was full or its dust duct was blocked.
reasons.someoneReturned: Cleaning was interrupted because someone returned home.
reasons.lowBattery: The vacuum battery was too low to continue cleaning the room.
reasons.dispatchTimeout: The room-cleaning request did not start within {{seconds}} seconds; try again.
reasons.dispatchTimeoutWithoutDuration: The room-cleaning request timed out without a verified duration; try again.
reasons.dispatchFailed: Home Assistant could not dispatch the room-cleaning request; try again.
reasons.resumeTimeout: The vacuum did not resume within {{seconds}} seconds; try again.
reasons.resumeTimeoutWithoutDuration: The vacuum resume request timed out without a verified duration; try again.
reasons.cleaningNotStarted: The vacuum never entered a cleaning state for the attempted room run; try again.
reasons.segmentNotReported: The vacuum never reported cleaning the requested room segment; try again.
reasons.durationBelowMinimum: Room cleaning lasted {{observed}} seconds, below the required minimum of {{minimum}} seconds.
reasons.durationBelowMinimumWithoutValues: Room-cleaning duration fell below the required minimum without verified values; retry.
reasons.areaBelowMinimumWithoutValues: The cleaned area of the room was below the required minimum.
reasons.estimatedRoomTimeBelowMinimum: Estimated time in the requested room was {{observed}} seconds, below the required minimum of {{minimum}} seconds.
reasons.estimatedRoomTimeBelowMinimumWithoutValu: Estimated time in the requested room was below the required minimum; reliable values were unavailable.
reasons.wrongRoom: Observed cleaning was dominated by {{dominantRoom}} for {{dominantSeconds}} seconds instead of the requested {{commandedRoom}} for {{commandedSeconds}} seconds.
reasons.wrongRoomWithoutNames: Observed cleaning time was dominated elsewhere, with {{dominantSeconds}} seconds versus {{commandedSeconds}} seconds in the requested room.
reasons.stuck: The vacuum became stuck while trying to clean the room.
reasons.roomUnreachable: The vacuum could not reach the requested room.
reasons.dockUnreachable: The vacuum could not reach its dock.
reasons.unknown: The vacuum outcome reason was not recognized.
